    • Constructor Detail

      • Board

        public Board()
        Instantiates a new board and generates a random valid starting grid.
        Ensures
        for (COLOUR c : grid){c != null}, !boardHasNeighbours(), grid[CENTER] = COLOUR.EMPTY.

      • Board

        public Board​(int[] boardValues)
        Instantiates a new board and assigns the values of boardValues to the grid.
        Parameters:
        boardValues - : the values of the grid
        Requires
        boardValues != null, boardValues.length == 49, boardValues[CENTER] == COLOUR.EMPTY.
        Ensures
        for (COLOUR c : grid){c != null}.

      • Board

        public Board​(COLOUR[] grid,
             java.util.List<Board.Move> nextMoves,
             java.util.List<COLOUR> p1Balls,
             java.util.List<COLOUR> p2Balls,
             boolean firstPlayerTurn)
        Instantiates a new board and clones the passed arguments to assign them to its own global variables. This constructor only used by deepCopy(). This constructor does not calculate the next moves since it is a copy of the current Board.
        Parameters:
        grid - : the grid
        nextMoves - : the next possible moves
        p1Balls - : p1 balls
        p2Balls - : p2 balls
        firstPlayerTurn - : whether it's currently the first player's turn
        Requires
        grid != null, nextMoves != null, p1Balls != null, p2Balls != null.
        Ensures
        this.grid = grid.clone(), this.possibleNextMoves.addAll(nextMoves), this.p1Balls.addAll(p1Balls) this.p2Balls.addAll(p2Balls). this.firstPlayerTurn = firstPlayerTurn;

    • Method Detail

      • makeMove

        public void makeMove​(int[] move)
        Play the passed move on the current Board. isValidMove() should be called before calling this method on the server.
        Parameters:
        move - : the move to be played on the Board.
        Requires
        isValidMove(int[] move).
        Ensures
        grid = findMove(move) if findMove(move) != null, p1Balls.addAll(m.gainedBalls) if firstPlayerTurn, p2Balls.addAll(m.gainedBalld) if !firstPlayerTurn.

      • boardHasNeighbours

        public boolean boardHasNeighbours()
        Checks whether the current grid on the Board has at least two balls of the same COLOUR, which are not COLOUR.EMPTY, and are adjacent to each other horizontally or vertically.

      • countPoints

        public int countPoints​(boolean playerOne)

        Parameters:
